script.title: Why Indians Buy Gold When Prices Hit Highs #shorts

segments.text: Gold prices just hit a two-week high in India.
Yet, gold demand this festive season is expected to surge by 12%.
Why do Indians buy more gold when it gets expensive, instead of less?
First, festive FOMO kicks in. Buyers worry prices will rise even higher tomorrow.
Second, jewelers offer heavy discounts on making charges during Dhanteras to lock in volume.
Remember, buying festival gold isn't financial advice, but a deep cultural habit.
So every year, regardless of record rates...
